lines.en: label bar5:
scene bareredux1
I walk into the bar to find absolutely no one- a small but noticeable change from last time.
lines.zh: 我走进酒吧，发现里面一个人也没有——跟上一次相比，这是个不大但挺明显的变化。

lines.en: I'm not really sure if this can be chalked up purely to me showing up late, either, considering Sana's already informed me of the struggling state of this business-
lines.zh: 我也不太确定这能不能纯粹归结为我来晚了，毕竟 Sana 早就跟我说过这生意有多艰难——

lines.en: But maybe it's even worse off than I thought?
lines.zh: 不过也许情况比我想的还要糟？

lines.en: At the bare minimum, there should be at least one customer half-passed out behind the counter, silently drinking to him- or, sorry, {i}her{/i}self.
lines.zh: 最起码，也该有一个顾客醉倒在吧台后面，默不作声地对着他——或者，抱歉，对着{i}她{/i}自己喝吧。

lines.en: I'm still not fully used to the idea of there not really being any men around here yet, I guess.
lines.zh: 我想我还是没太习惯“这一带其实没什么男人”这件事。

lines.en: scene bareredux2
: Umm...Hi, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你好，老师……

lines.en: : Hey, Sana. Where is everybody?
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sana。大家都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : This...{i}is{/i} everybody...
lines.zh: : 这就{i}是{/i}……所有人了……

lines.en: if day < 6:
: Weekdays...aren’t really that busy for us...
lines.zh: : 工作日……我们这儿真的不怎么忙……

lines.en: else:
: Weekends...aren’t really that busy for us...
lines.zh: : 周末……也真的不怎么忙……

lines.en: : Yeah...I can see that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我看得出来。

lines.en: : Would you mind if I took a seat? I’ve been walking for a while and I’m pretty exhausted.
lines.zh: : 介意我坐一会儿吗？我走了挺久的路，累坏了。

lines.en: scene bareredux3
: O-Oh! Right! I’m...so sorry...I shouldn't have stopped you as soon as you walked in...
lines.zh: : 啊、啊！对！我……真的很抱歉……你一进门我就不该拦着你的……

lines.en: : It’s fine. You were probably just so excited to see another human lifeform in here that you couldn't help but approach me as soon as the door opened.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你大概是看到这里终于出现了另一个活人，太激动了，门一开就忍不住凑过来。

lines.en: scene bareredux4
: What's...really sad is that...you're probably not wrong...
lines.zh: : 可悲的是……你说的……大概没错……

lines.en: : Is it...okay if I sit next to you, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过……我可以坐在你旁边吗？……

lines.en: : What if another customer shows up, though?
lines.zh: : 那要是有别的客人来了怎么办？

lines.en: scene bareredux5
: I...don’t really think we have to worry about that...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我们不用操心这个……

lines.en: : I was...probably just going to close down soon anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 我……大概反正也准备要打烊了，所以……

lines.en: : Then, sure. I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 那当然可以。我一点也不介意。

lines.en: : It might be a good time to start your {i}lessons{/i} anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正现在开始{i}上课{/i}也挺合适的。

lines.en: scene black
: As...good a time as any, I guess...
lines.zh: : 反正……什么时候都一样吧，我想……

lines.en: Sana leads me over to the bar and politely pulls out a stool for me despite it being larger than her and probably weighing twice as much.
lines.zh: Sana 领着我走到吧台前，礼貌地替我拉开一张凳子——尽管那张凳子比她还大，重量大概还是她两倍。

lines.en: She may not have much faith in the business, but at least she's attentive when it comes to customers.
lines.zh: 她可能对这生意没什么信心，但至少在招待客人这件事上很上心。

lines.en: Or at least me.
lines.zh: 至少对我是这样。

lines.en: To be fair, though, there haven’t been many opportunities to see how she acts around others.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，也没什么机会看到她怎么跟别人相处。

lines.en: scene barfive1
I kick off the lesson by remaining completely silent and just observing how Sana acts around me.
lines.zh: 我以彻底的沉默开了课，只是观察 Sana 在我面前是什么反应。

lines.en: And, if she had the confidence in herself to even look my way, she'd be made immediately aware of how creepy and unacceptable this method is.
lines.zh: 而如果她有哪怕一点点自信肯抬眼看我，她立刻就会发现这招有多变态、多不像话。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her, her inability to make eye contact has already resulted in her missing out on a valuable lesson.
lines.zh: 可惜对她来说，她没法跟人对视这件事，已经让她白白错过了一堂宝贵的课。

lines.en: Here's hoping she's at least {i}tried{/i} practicing in some way during my absence.
lines.zh: 只希望我不在的这段时间里，她至少{i}试着{/i}练过。

lines.en: : So, any progress on your end lately? Have you been able to hold any conversations with anyone you're not directly related to?
lines.zh: : 那么，你最近有什么进展吗？有没有跟任何一个跟你没有直接血缘关系的人说过话？

lines.en: scene barfive2
: Well...there's Ayane too, but...other than that...not really...
lines.zh: : 嗯……还有 Ayane 吧，不过……除此之外……基本没有……

lines.en: : I’ve been trying...but...
lines.zh: : 我一直在努力……可是……

lines.en: Sana drifts off, as if she's expecting me to fill in the blanks of her inadequacies.
lines.zh: Sana 的声音渐渐低了下去，像是期待我来替她把那些说不出口的不足补完。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, I probably could. But me doing the legwork isn't going to help her in any way.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我大概确实补得上。可我来替她包办，对她一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: If she's going to improve herself, she first needs to confront her problems head on.
lines.zh: 她要是想提升自己，首先得正面面对自己的问题。

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 可是什么？

lines.en: : It’s just...kind of hard without anyone to talk to...
lines.zh: : 只是……没人可以说话的话……有点难……

lines.en: : I guess that's fair.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: : Maybe try practicing in the mirror or something? Isn't that what actors do when they're first starting out?
lines.zh: : 要不试试对着镜子练？演员刚入行的时候不都这么干吗？

lines.en: scene barfive3
: Does that...actually work?...
lines.zh: : 那……真的有用吗？……

lines.en: : Maybe. I've never tried. Just...pretend you’re someone else and try to strike up a conversation while...playing both sides?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我没试过。就是……假装你是另一个人，然后试着搭话，同时……演两个人的角色？

lines.en: scene barfive1
: That sounds...way too complicated...
lines.zh: : 那听起来……太复杂了……

lines.en: : Plus...I don’t really like mirrors...so...
lines.zh: : 而且……我不太喜欢镜子……所以……

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : It's...kind of personal, so...if you don't mind...
lines.zh: : 这……有点私人，所以……如果你不介意的话……

lines.en: : Don't worry about it, then. We can just keep going like this.
lines.zh: : 那就别在意了。我们就这样继续吧。

lines.en: I can't blame Sana for not wanting to just freely divulge personal information to me now that we're talking somewhat regularly.
lines.zh: 如今我们算是聊得比较频繁了，Sana 不愿随口就把私事告诉我，这也怪不得她。

lines.en: No one should trust anyone until they're given a reason to- and I am no exception to that.
lines.zh: 在没有理由之前，谁都不该信任谁——我也不例外。

lines.en: Sana needs time to grow.
lines.zh: Sana 需要时间成长。

lines.en: Mentally, at least. Because, to be quite honest, I hope she stays her current size forever.
lines.zh: 至少是心理上的。因为说句老实话，我真希望她永远保持现在这个尺寸。

lines.en: : Here's an idea, Sana. How about we try a little roleplay?
lines.zh: : Sana，我有个主意。我们不如来点角色扮演？

lines.en: scene barfive3
: Roleplay?...You mean like...a game?
lines.zh: : 角色扮演？……你是说……像做游戏那样？

lines.en: : Sure. You can call it a game if you want. Just pretend I’m a customer and-
lines.zh: : 对。你想叫它游戏也行。就假装我是客人，然后——

lines.en: : Well, actually, I {i}am{/i} a customer. But I’m sure you know where I’m going with this.
lines.zh: : 其实我本来{i}就是{/i}客人。不过我想你知道我要说什么。

lines.en: scene barfive4
: Uh...yeah...if...if it's just a game...I can...probably do it...
lines.zh: : 呃……好……如果……如果只是游戏的话……我……应该做得到……

lines.en: : Just to mix things up, though, I’m going to try and be difficult. Got it?
lines.zh: : 不过为了增加难度，我打算故意刁难你一下。懂吗？

lines.en: scene barfive3
: Difficult? How so?
lines.zh: : 刁难？怎么个刁难？

lines.en: : I mean that I’m going to give you problems that might arise at the bar and you’re going to need to figure out what to do about them.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我会给你出一些酒吧里可能会发生的问题，你得想办法处理。

lines.en: scene barfive5
: You’re not...going to break anything...are you?
lines.zh: : 你……不会打碎什么东西……吧？

lines.en: : Because...it comes out of my paycheck if you do...
lines.zh: : 因为……打碎的话要从我工资里扣……

lines.en: : First off, no. Second, do you really have to pay for things that break on your shift here?
lines.zh: : 第一，不会。第二，你在这儿上班时打碎的东西，真的得你自己赔吗？

lines.en: : Well...no...But I’d...feel really bad if I didn’t...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不用……可是……我要是不赔的话……会觉得很过意不去……

lines.en: scene barfive2
: Not having customers means my mom doesn't have much money, and...I wouldn't want her to pay for all of that out of pocket...
lines.zh: : 没有客人就说明我妈妈没什么钱，而且……我不想让她自己掏腰包承担那些……

lines.en: : So...if I can help by...paying for a few broken glasses...I don't really mind...
lines.zh: : 所以……如果我能帮上忙……赔几个碎杯子的话……我真的不介意……

lines.en: I guess this means I can assume Sana’s dad isn’t in the picture either.
lines.zh: 看来我可以断定，Sana 的爸爸也不在身边了。

lines.en: Is it really just Sana and her mom trying to keep this place afloat on their own? No wonder why they're going under.
lines.zh: 真的只有 Sana 和她妈妈两个人在硬撑着这家店吗？难怪她们撑不下去了。

lines.en: There's only so much two people can do- especially when it comes to maintaining a place like this.
lines.zh: 两个人能做的事终归有限——尤其还是维持这样一个地方。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I promise to not break anything. I’ll just act kind of rude toward you or something.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我保证不打碎任何东西。我就表现得……有点粗鲁之类的。

lines.en: : Will you be able to handle that?
lines.zh: : 你应付得来吗？

lines.en: scene barfive5
: Well...can you tell me how rude you’re going to be?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你能先告诉我你要有多粗鲁吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Sana, hurry up and get behind the bar. This is a trial by fire.
lines.zh: : Sana，快点站到吧台后面去。这叫实战演练。

lines.en: : But...our extinguisher is...really old and...I don't know if it still works...
lines.zh: : 可是……我们的灭火器……很旧了，而且……我不知道还能不能用……

lines.en: : I'm going to ignore that extreme safety hazard for now and say it again. Get behind the bar.
lines.zh: : 我先无视这个重大安全隐患，再说一遍。站到吧台后面去。

lines.en: : Okay, but...I can already tell...I'm going to fail whatever this is...
lines.zh: : 好的，可是……我已经能预感到了……不管这是什么，我都会搞砸的……

lines.en: scene black
Sana gets out of her seat and nervously rounds the corner into the bar area...
lines.zh: Sana 从座位上站起来，紧张地绕过转角走进了吧台区……

lines.en: She closes her eyes and takes a deep breath, though I'm not sure how much benefit it will have since I don't intend to pull any punches with this.
lines.zh: 她闭上眼睛深吸了一口气，不过我不确定这能有多大用，因为我根本不打算手下留情。

lines.en: scene firstbar4
: Umm...Hello, sir...What can I-
lines.zh: : 嗯……您好，先生……请问您要——

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. Give me a beer and a plate of spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 行了行了。给我来杯啤酒，再来一盘意面。

lines.en: scene barfive6
: A plate of...spaghetti?...
lines.zh: : 一盘……意面？……

lines.en: : Did I stutter? Or are you just really fucking bad at your job?
lines.zh: : 我口吃了吗？还是说你的工作干得实在太他妈烂了？

lines.en: : Well...I don't think so...but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得没有……可是……

lines.en: scene barfive7
: Listen kid, I’m in a hurry. So if you don’t have my spaghetti in five minutes, I’m gonna have to-
lines.zh: : 听着，小鬼，我赶时间。要是五分钟内我的意面还没上来，我就得——

lines.en: : Wait, Sana, are you crying? We literally just started.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sana，你哭了？我们才刚开始啊。

lines.en: : W...w...we...d...don’t...have any...s...sp...spaghetti...
This is even worse than I thought.
lines.zh: 这比我想的还要糟。

lines.en: : Sana, if this is too hard-
lines.zh: : Sana，要是这太难了——

lines.en: scene barfive8
: I’LLGOGETYOURBEER!!!
lines.zh: : 我这就去给您拿啤酒！！！

lines.en: scene firstbarnone
"Sana sprints over to the opposite side of the bar and trips over one of the mats on the
lines.zh: “Sana 冲向吧台另一侧，被地上的一张地垫绊了一跤，

lines.en: ground, knocking a few things off the counter."
lines.zh: 把台面上的几样东西撞了下来。“

lines.en: She scrambles to pick them all up and quickly pulls the first bottle she sees out of the cooler.
lines.zh: 她手忙脚乱地把东西全捡起来，又赶紧从冷藏柜里抽出第一眼看到的那瓶酒。

lines.en: scene barfive9
: H...Here it is...your...
lines.zh: : 给……给您……您的……

lines.en: scene barfive9r
: Your...
lines.zh: : 您的……

lines.en: scene barfive10
: Ah!
scene barfive11
: I’LLBERIGHTBACK!!!
lines.zh: : 我马上就回来！！！

lines.en: scene firstbarnone
This is hard to watch.
lines.zh: 这真是不忍直视。

lines.en: scene barfive12
: Don’t laugh at me...
lines.zh: : 别笑我……

lines.en: : I’m not laughing. In fact, I feel like I owe you an apology.
lines.zh: : 我没笑。事实上，我觉得我欠你一个道歉。

lines.en: scene barfive13
: No...You don’t...I’m just not really used to...dealing with pressure...
lines.zh: : 不……您不用……我只是不太习惯……应对压力……

lines.en: : No one has ever asked for spaghetti before...I didn’t know how to handle it...
lines.zh: : 从来没有人点过意面……我不知道该怎么处理……

lines.en: : Well, if it makes you feel any better, I don't think a real customer will ever ask for spaghetti. Especially considering you don't have a menu.
lines.zh: : 好吧，要是这能让你好受一点的话，我觉得真正的客人是不会点意面的。尤其考虑到你们连菜单都没有。

lines.en: : But, in the event that someone does, it’s always okay to just tell them that you don’t have any.
lines.zh: : 不过万一真有人点，你完全可以直说你们没有。

lines.en: scene barfive12
: B...But when I tried that and you...said...
lines.zh: : 可、可是我刚才那么说了，然后你就……

lines.en: : What I said doesn't matter.
lines.zh: : 我说什么不重要。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ve heard that whole thing about how the customer is always correct, right?
lines.zh: : 你肯定听过那句“顾客永远是对的”吧？

lines.en: : Well, that’s not true. In fact, the customer is pretty much always wrong.
lines.zh: : 那不是真的。事实上，顾客基本永远是错的。

lines.en: : You know this place better than they do, so be assertive and tell me that you don’t have any spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 你比他们更了解这个地方，所以硬气一点，告诉我你们没有意面。

lines.en: : Like...Like right now?...
lines.zh: : 就……就现在吗？……

lines.en: : Right now.
lines.zh: : 就现在。

lines.en: : Deny me the spaghetti, Sana.
lines.zh: : 拒绝给我意面，Sana。
: 我们……

lines.en: : We don’t have any spaghetti...
lines.zh: : 我们没有意面……

lines.en: : Perfect. That concludes our lesson for the day.
lines.zh: : 完美。今天的课就上到这里。

lines.en: scene black
scene barfive14
: I’m...so confused...
lines.zh: : 我……好困惑……

lines.en: : Was that...really supposed to help?...
lines.zh: : 那……真的有用吗？……

lines.en: : It probably could have gone a little better on both of our ends. But don't be surprised if you wake up tomorrow and you're suddenly an expert at talking to people.
lines.zh: : 我们双方大概都本可以做得更好一点。不过要是你明天一觉醒来，突然变成了跟人聊天的专家，也别太惊讶。

lines.en: scene barfive15
: Well...at least it was...a little fun?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少……有那么一点开心？……

lines.en: : Are you still crying?
lines.zh: : 你还在哭吗？

lines.en: : Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: : I’ll...try not to freak out next time! I promise!
lines.zh: : 我……下次会努力不慌的！我保证！

lines.en: : And I will try not to make you cry. But, honestly, I'm not sure how much good that's going to do when all it took was spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 我也会努力不把你弄哭。不过说实话，光是一盘意面就够了，我不确定这能有多大用。

lines.en: : It was...more the...context of the spaghetti that...made me cry...
lines.zh: : 让我哭的……与其说是意面……不如说是那个意面出现的情境……

lines.en: : I'm sure it was, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我想是的，Sana。

lines.en: scene black
: I'm sure it was.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: Sana and I say our goodbyes and she walks me to the door so she can lock it behind me.
lines.zh: Sana 和我道了别，她把我送到门口，好在我出去之后把门锁上。

lines.en: Was today actually successful in teaching her anything?
lines.zh: 今天真的教会她什么了吗？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: But, like she said-
lines.zh: 不过，就像她说的——

lines.en: At least it was a little fun.
lines.zh: 至少还挺开心的。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
$ bar5 = True
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}

lines.en: if day < 6:
jump endofweekday
else:
jump endofsat
